domain_reviews.notes: Modular-core-first, canonical contracts, explicit service-extraction candidates and provider/country-neutral architecture are mutually consistent.
Event/receive/observed time, raw/versioned evidence, macro vintages, feature lineage and replay manifests are consistent.
Evidence-family model preserves provenance, WAIT/NO_TRADE and correlation-aware anti-double-counting.
Probability is empirical/calibrated or unavailable; exact algorithms and validation remain correctly deferred.
Independent veto/reduction authority is non-bypassable; Risk cannot raise its own ceilings; Firewall fails closed.
UNKNOWN/RECONCILING states, stable idempotency identity and no blind cross-broker replay protect execution uncertainty.
Experiment artifacts retain lineage; learning can propose but not auto-promote to Live.
Least privilege, tool gateway, execution enclave, secrets boundary and quarantine are architecturally defined. Threat model/RBAC/MFA/secrets implementation belongs to P03.
Topology and provisional capacity/DR envelopes are sufficient for engineering selection; measured RPO/RTO and capacity validation remain P04/P22 obligations.
Architecture decisions are traceable to governed tasks/PR/CI evidence. Final G2 requires this review PR and post-merge evidence.
No active conflicting lock; G2 does not require Owner Human Gate; future baseline changes remain governed.

architecture_invariants_verified: GitHub main + merged CI evidence remains technical source of truth
Modular core first; no microservices-by-default
Provider SDK/schema does not become core domain contract
Country/location is not an architecture dependency
Event/source/receive/observed time semantics are explicit
Corrections/revisions do not silently overwrite historical truth
Evidence families prevent indicator-count double counting
Probability is empirical/calibrated or explicitly unavailable
SignalCandidate is non-executable
Risk and Pre-Trade Firewall remain independent veto authorities
Execution uses stable idempotency identity and explicit UNKNOWN/RECONCILING states
Blind automatic cross-broker failover is forbidden
Auto-promote-to-Live is forbidden
Agent/tool availability is not permission
A5/A8 veto cannot be overridden by agent consensus
DEV/TEST/RESEARCH/DEMO/SHADOW/CANARY/LIVE are separate authority contexts
SHADOW has no live command path
Public ingress cannot directly reach execution/secrets
DR recovery requires reconciliation before new risk-increasing execution
Capacity/cost numeric assumptions are provisional until measured
Live Trading and Auto Trading remain disabled

cross_architecture_consistency_checks.detail: Primary decision path is directional; feedback uses events/read models rather than hidden state mutation.
Only quality-qualified/versioned evidence feeds decision architecture.
SignalCandidate carries evidence/probability/uncertainty but no executable broker command or final size authority.
RiskVerdict and deterministic FirewallVerdict precede OMS; no bypass path is defined.
Agents use governed domain/tool APIs; Governance Kernel/Tool Gateway enforce role/task/resource permissions.
Credentials and mutable execution state do not promote across environments; lower environments cannot write CANARY/LIVE.
Restored state does not authorize execution until broker truth and Risk/Firewall state are reconciled.
Budget pressure may shed research but cannot disable Risk/Security/Audit/Reconciliation/Kill Switches.
